missing.title: That customer is not here any more
missing.text: The account may have been deleted. Open it again from the customers list.

banner.title: Deactivated today.
banner.text: Reason kept on the account: {{reason}}. Their running orders are not touched.

orders.title: Orders
orders.note: An admin reads these. Only the stall moves an order through its states, so there is nothing to change here.

reviews.title: Reviews they wrote
reviews.note: Hiding a review is done from Moderation, where the report that triggered it is visible too.

whatItDoes.title: What deactivating does
whatItDoes.text: They cannot sign in or place a new order. Orders already placed are not touched, so a stall still hands over what it has set aside and nobody loses food that was picked for them.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.text: They cannot sign in or order again until an admin reactivates them. Orders already placed run to the end, so no stall is left holding food nobody collects.

reason.requested: Asked for their account to be closed
